notes.title: Ver.1.0.5
notes.content:
- We have implemented a new hidden object that allows you to change the color of the shirt the main character is wearing.
- "Macho'', who can be summoned with a hidden skill, has learned to jump.
- Reduced the screen motion blur effect on some maps.
*There are (probably) no changes to the game's difficulty in this update.

notes.title: Ver.1.0.5
notes.content:
- Optimized the game data (lightweight) to improve performance.
*There are no changes to the difficulty level of the game in this update.

notes.title: Ver.1.0.4
notes.content:
・Fixed an issue where the "Number of courses cleared GREAT" would not be counted correctly under certain conditions.
- Corrected the stage name that was written incorrectly. (G15)
*There are no changes to the difficulty level of the game in this update.

notes.title: Ver.1.0.2
notes.content:

*There are no changes to the difficulty level of the game in this update.
